notes: ABI proven from the sole call site and callee body: cdecl with two
arguments. 0x53a7c8 pushes [EBP+0xc], then 0x53a7c9 pushes EDI (owner);
0x483487 reads arg1 at [EBP+8], and 0x4836cd is a plain RET.
Startup forwards vehicle index param_3 as arg2; 0x483450 never reads it.
The return is binary32 in ST0: 0x53a7ff FCOM compares it against 0x0.
Ghidra's pseudocode and direct assembly agree that this call has two
arguments. 0x52d070(0) selects the first node through resource+0x21c.
Arg1 is a pointer, not a number: 0x483487 loads [EBP+8] into EAX and
0x48348a dereferences it at +0x490. The FIMUL [EBP+8] on the last block
belongs to a different path, and that slot is overwritten with ECX at
0x4836c4 before the divide, so it reads a reused scratch value.
Body characterization: the routine asks 0x006ee510 for a 0x12e32-byte
raster buffer tagged by the string at 0x890238, zeroes it, then walks
per-surface geometry indexed by a 16-bit surface id (model+0x420,
+0x620, +0x720, triangle data at +0x48 and +0x2038), accumulating
surface area. The decoded-geometry scene traversal, per-face raster
path and area-density formula now have portable bounded implementations.
Decoded FCE parts and scene nodes now adapt into the portable area path.
The raw entry still needs resource/list lifetime, real allocation, startup
wiring, and installed-asset binary32 validation.
